steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 手的位置为两臂向量和：$x=16\cos30^\circ+12\cos45^\circ=6 \sqrt{2} + 8 \sqrt{3}$；$y=16\sin30^\circ+12\sin45^\circ=8 + 6 \sqrt{2}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\approx27.765365\text{ in.},\quad\theta=\tan^{-1}(y/x)\approx36.422537^\circ$。点在第一象限，故角无需补180度。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 最后才四舍五入，得 $(r,\theta)\approx(27.8\text{ in.},36.4^\circ)$。极坐标还原分量与前述和一致。

steps.body: Add the arm vectors: $x=16\cos30^\circ+12\cos45^\circ=6 \sqrt{2} + 8 \sqrt{3}$; $y=16\sin30^\circ+12\sin45^\circ=8 + 6 \sqrt{2}$.

steps.body: $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\approx27.765365\text{ in.},\quad\theta=\tan^{-1}(y/x)\approx36.422537^\circ$. The point is in quadrant I, so no 180-degree adjustment is needed.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Round only at the end to obtain $(r,\theta)\approx(27.8\text{ in.},36.4^\circ)$. The polar components recover the vector sum.

steps.body: 代入 $x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta$，展开得 $r^2-2r\cos\theta+2r\sin\theta=0\iff r(r-2\cos\theta+2\sin\theta)=0$。

questions.prompt: 把各极方程转为直角方程，并指出图形：(a) $r=3$；(b) $\theta=45^\circ$；(c) $r=\csc\theta$；(d) $r=2\cos\theta$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) $r=3$，使用 $r^2=x^2+y^2$ 得 $x^2+y^2=9$，是圆心原点、半径3的圆。原极方程的有效表示与该曲线的点相符。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) $\theta=45^\circ$，使用 $\tan\theta=y/x$ 得 $y=x$，是过原点、倾角45度的直线。固定角允许正负 $r$，所以是整条直线；极点也在图上。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (c) $r=\csc\theta$，使用 $r\sin\theta=y$ 得 $y=1$，是水平直线。原极方程的有效表示与该曲线的点相符。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (d) $r=2\cos\theta$，使用 $r^2=2r\cos\theta=2x$ 得 $(x-1)^2+y^2=1$，是圆心(1,0)、半径1的圆。原极方程的有效表示与该曲线的点相符。

questions.answer: (a) $x^2+y^2=9$：圆心原点、半径3的圆；(b) $y=x$：过原点、倾角45度的直线；(c) $y=1$：水平直线；(d) $(x-1)^2+y^2=1$：圆心(1,0)、半径1的圆

en.prompt: Convert each polar equation to a rectangular equation and identify its graph: (a) $r=3$；(b) $\theta=45^\circ$；(c) $r=\csc\theta$；(d) $r=2\cos\theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) From $r=3$, use $r^2=x^2+y^2$ to obtain $x^2+y^2=9$, a circle centered at the origin, radius 3. The valid polar representations give precisely this curve.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) From $\theta=45^\circ$, use $\tan\theta=y/x$ to obtain $y=x$, a line through the origin at angle 45 degrees. A fixed angle permits both signs of $r$, so the entire line is included, including the pole.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (c) From $r=\csc\theta$, use $r\sin\theta=y$ to obtain $y=1$, a horizontal line. The valid polar representations give precisely this curve.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (d) From $r=2\cos\theta$, use $r^2=2r\cos\theta=2x$ to obtain $(x-1)^2+y^2=1$, a circle centered at (1,0), radius 1. The valid polar representations give precisely this curve.

en.answer: (a) $x^2+y^2=9$: circle centered at the origin, radius 3; (b) $y=x$: line through the origin at angle 45 degrees; (c) $y=1$: horizontal line; (d) $(x-1)^2+y^2=1$: circle centered at (1,0), radius 1

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 选标准非负半径 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$。非极点必须 $x>0$，否则原式迫使 $y=0$。所以 $0\le\theta<\pi/2$ 且 $0<r<\pi/2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入 $r\sin\theta=r\cos\theta\tan r$，除非零的 $r\cos\theta$ 得 $\tan\theta=\tan r$。两角均在 $[0,\pi/2)$，故 $r=\theta$。原点对应 $r=\theta=0$，可补入。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Choose standard nonnegative radius $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$. At a nonzero point, $x>0$ because $x=0$ would force $y=0$. Thus $0\le\theta<\pi/2$ and $0<r<\pi/2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute $r\sin\theta=r\cos\theta\tan r$ and divide by nonzero $r\cos\theta$ to get $\tan\theta=\tan r$. Both angles lie in $[0,\pi/2)$, so $r=\theta$. The origin is obtained by $r=\theta=0$ and is included.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 对数要求 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}>0$，原式排除 $x=0$ 的非零点。故 $0\le\theta<\pi/2$ 且 $0<r<\pi/2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入并除以 $r\cos\theta$，得 $\tan\theta=\tan(\ln r)$，所以 $\ln r=\theta+k\pi$，$k\in\mathbb Z$。不能把 $\ln r$ 错限为反正切主值。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 完整解为 $r=e^{\theta+k\pi}$，再取 $r<\pi/2$。等价地，$k\le-1$ 时 $0\le\theta<\pi/2$；$k=0$ 时 $0\le\theta<\ln(\pi/2)$。所有分支代回有 $\tan(\ln r)=\tan\theta$。

steps.body: 图中示出 $k=0,-1,-2,-3$；还有无限多个更小分支趋近极点，但极点不在定义域内。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute and divide by $r\cos\theta$ to get $\tan\theta=\tan(\ln r)$. Hence $\ln r=\theta+k\pi$, $k\in\mathbb Z$. Do not incorrectly restrict $\ln r$ to the principal arctangent range.

steps.body: (b) 固定非零 $r$，点在半径 $|r|$ 的圆上，$\theta$增加时逆时针转动；负角从极轴按顺时针测量。$r<0$ 时点还要与终边反向，但增加角仍逆时针；$r=0$ 时点固定在极点。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (c) 加整圈不改变终边，换半径符号再加半圈也不改变点：$(r,\theta+2k\pi)$、$(-r,\theta+(2k+1)\pi)$ 都表示同一点。极点的角可任意。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) With fixed $\theta$, the point moves along its line: $r>0$ lies on the terminal ray and $r<0$ on the opposite ray. Increasing a negative $r$ toward 0 approaches the pole; beyond 0 it moves away along the positive ray. Distance from the pole is $|r|$, so increasing $r$ does not always increase distance.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) For fixed nonzero $r$, the point moves on a circle of radius $|r|$; increasing $\theta$ moves counterclockwise. Negative angles are measured clockwise from the polar axis. A negative $r$ puts the point opposite the terminal ray but still moves counterclockwise as the angle increases. For $r=0$, the point stays at the pole.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (c) Full turns preserve the terminal ray; reversing the radius and adding a half-turn also preserves the point. Thus $(r,\theta+2k\pi)$ and $(-r,\theta+(2k+1)\pi)$ represent the same point, and the pole permits any angle.
